skill.name: longbridge-research
skill.description: Longbridge Research helps investors and analysts organize equity research using Longbridge market data. It covers analyst ratings, forecasts, calendars, ownership, short interest, peer analysis, and research memo workflows.
skill.summary: Equity research workflows for Longbridge ratings, forecasts, ownership data, calendars, and peer analysis.
skill.author: longbridge

security_audit.summary: The static command-execution, network, and reconnaissance findings are false positives caused by Markdown command examples and prose. No prompt injection or executable code was found in the reviewed files. One semantic issue remains: the skill under-declares account authorization and portfolio-data access for calendar workflows.

remediation.suggestion: Update metadata and user-facing documentation to state when holdings or watchlist access requires Longbridge authorization.

remediation.issue: Sensitive portfolio data workflows need explicit consent boundaries.
remediation.suggestion: Before retrieving holdings or watchlists, prompt for consent and explain what data is accessed and how it is used.

remediation.issue: Markdown command examples trigger static command-execution heuristics.
remediation.suggestion: Label CLI examples as documentation and avoid unnecessary inline backticks where plain text would be clear.

semantic_findings.title: Undeclared Account Data Access
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md declares requires_login false, but finance-calendar.md says account authorization is required and instructs retrieval of holdings and watchlists. This can mislead users about access to sensitive portfolio data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The metadata and workflow text directly conflict, and the workflow names holdings and watchlist retrieval. The issue is disclosure and consent for sensitive financial data, not code execution.

content.value_statement: Investors need reliable market data for research, events, and ownership signals. This skill organizes Longbridge data into structured equity research workflows.
actual_capabilities: Routes analyst ratings, consensus targets, EPS forecasts, and finance calendar requests to dedicated workflows.
Guides Longbridge CLI use for shareholder, fund holder, insider trade, 13F, short interest, and short volume data.
Provides frameworks for stock research, investment proposals, coverage initiation, competitive analysis, and thesis tracking.
Supports research across US, HK, SG, and CN symbols when Longbridge commands support those markets.
Includes DeFi yield and on-chain analysis guidance using public web sources when Longbridge data is unavailable.
Adapts responses to Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, or English.
limitations: Many workflows depend on the longbridge-terminal CLI or an MCP fallback being available.
Some calendar workflows may require Longbridge account authorization for holdings and watchlist data.
The skill does not provide investment advice or direct buy and sell recommendations.
Market data freshness depends on Longbridge and cited public sources.

use_cases.title: Track Portfolio Events
use_cases.description: Review upcoming earnings, dividends, macro events, and market themes that may affect holdings or watchlists.

use_cases.title: Build Equity Research Briefs
use_cases.description: Combine ratings, forecasts, valuation, news, and price action into a structured stock research snapshot.

use_cases.title: Monitor Market Positioning
use_cases.description: Analyze shareholder changes, fund holders, insider trades, short interest, and peer rankings for risk signals.

prompt_templates.title: Check Analyst View
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Longbridge Research to summarize analyst ratings, target price, and EPS forecasts for NVDA.US. Explain the main positives and risks.

prompt_templates.title: Review Upcoming Events
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a finance calendar for my watchlist this week. Separate earnings, dividends, macro events, and market opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Industry Peers
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze AAPL.US against three close peers. Include valuation, growth, margins, moat, and disruptor risks.

prompt_templates.title: Build Investment Memo
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a balanced investment proposal for TSLA.US using Longbridge ratings, forecasts, shareholder data, short interest, news, and key risks.

output_examples.input: Summarize the analyst view for NVDA.US.
output_examples.output: The response would show rating distribution, target price direction, forecast trends, and balanced bull and bear points.

output_examples.input: What events affect my watchlist this week?
output: A dated timeline of earnings, dividends, macro releases, and market events.
Short impact notes for important events and affected securities.
A disclaimer that the report is for reference only.

output_examples.output: The response would identify peers, compare valuation and growth metrics, assess moat strength, and summarize competitive risks.

best_practices: Confirm the symbol format before requesting market data.
Ask for source dates when using time-sensitive research outputs.
Use the research as support, then apply independent judgment before trading.
anti_patterns: Treating outputs as personalized investment advice.
Requesting direct buy or sell instructions.
Assuming unauthenticated access can retrieve private holdings or watchlists.

faq.question: Does this skill place trades?
faq.answer: No. It supports research and analysis only. It does not place orders or manage accounts.

faq.question: Does it need a Longbridge account?
faq.answer: Public research commands may work without login. Holdings and watchlist calendar workflows may require Longbridge authorization.

faq.question: Which markets can it research?
faq.answer: Support depends on each Longbridge command. The references include US, HK, SG, CN, SH, and SZ examples.

faq.question: Can it respond in Chinese?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can match Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, or English input.

faq.question: Can it analyze DeFi or on-chain data?
faq.answer: Yes, but those workflows rely on public web sources when Longbridge data is not available.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
